# Summit Voice AI

> Summit Voice AI builds "Ava," a done-for-you AI voice receptionist and revenue recovery
> automation system. Ava answers every inbound call in under 1 second, 24/7/365, qualifies
> and books the caller directly onto the calendar, follows up on unsold estimates, reactivates
> old leads sitting in the CRM, and requests reviews after the job is done — all without a
> human touching it. Summit Voice AI is built and operated by Summit Marketing Group,
> founded by Dan Gill.

## What we do

Summit Voice AI installs the Summit Revenue Recovery System™: an AI voice agent (Ava) plus
a connected set of automations — missed-call recovery, speed-to-lead follow-up, SMS/email
nurture, database reactivation campaigns, and a review-generation workflow — wired directly
into the client's existing CRM and calendar. The core premise: most businesses lose more
revenue to missed calls, slow follow-up, and dead CRM leads than they do to a lack of new
leads. Summit Voice AI's job is to recover that leakage before the client spends more money
generating new opportunities.

The mechanism is called the Revenue Recovery Loop™: Capture → Respond → Follow Up →
Reactivate → Book → Review → Optimize.

## Who we serve

Primary focus: **roofing contractors** in the United States, typically $1M–$10M+ in annual
revenue, owner-operated with 1–10 employees.

Also actively serving: home services businesses (HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, pool and spa
companies), real estate teams and brokerages, healthcare and dental practices, law firms and
legal services, automotive service businesses, and other professional services companies
with high call volume and time-sensitive leads. Service area is nationwide across the United
States.

## Pricing

Three tiers, all month-to-month with a one-time implementation fee:

- **SummitVoice AI Capture™** — $697/month + $1,500 implementation. Entry tier: 24/7 AI
  receptionist, lead qualification, calendar booking, call summaries, basic CRM integration,
  missed-call recovery, monthly reporting.
- **Summit Revenue Recovery System™** — $1,497/month + $3,000 implementation (flagship /
  most popular). Everything in Capture, plus advanced missed-call recovery, speed-to-lead
  follow-up, SMS/email nurturing, the Estimate Rescue System™, a Review Growth Engine,
  website conversational AI, CRM/calendar workflow automation, an initial database
  reactivation campaign, a Revenue Recovery Scorecard, monthly optimization, quarterly
  reactivation campaigns, and the Revenue Recovery Script Vault. Annual prepay: $16,500 +
  implementation.
- **Summit AI Growth Engine™** — $2,497/month + $5,000 implementation. Everything in Revenue
  Recovery, plus outbound AI calling, multiple concurrent campaigns, larger database
  programs, multi-location support, advanced custom integrations, additional AI agents,
  higher usage allowances, priority support, and a monthly strategy session.

## Documented results

- Teo Roofing: 582 appointments booked in 12 months via Ava. At a 55% close rate averaging
  $13,100/job, that is $4,190,400+ in recovered revenue from a single AI receptionist.
- 42+ active roofing and home-service businesses on the platform.
- $84M+ in client revenue recovered annually across active clients.
- 100% call answer rate, under 1 second average answer time.
- A roofing database reactivation campaign of ~4,000 existing leads produced ~294
  appointments and ~$200,000 in attributable reported revenue (broader engagement across
  the same campaign reached ~600 appointments total).

Named clients: Teo Roofing, Stonewall Roofing, Black Label Roofing, Impact Roofing, Proof
Roofing.

## Implementation guarantee

If the client completes onboarding, provides required access, and meets agreed
prerequisites, and Summit has not deployed the agreed Revenue Recovery infrastructure
within 30 days, Summit continues implementation at no management fee until the agreed
system is live. If after the first 60 days Summit cannot point to measurable recovered
conversations, appointments, opportunities, or documented improvements in
response/follow-up performance, Summit will personally review the account and build an
additional recovery campaign at Summit's cost. Terms and prerequisites apply — this is a
deployment guarantee, not a guarantee of leads, appointments, sales, or revenue.
